headline: As of 2026-10-31: 53,243,226 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 53,243,226 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,708,006), California (5,545,910), Florida (4,917,659).
